explication: Besom is a Scala SDK and Pulumi language plugin for declaring, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure. The principal workflow is: an engineer writes a Scala program, Pulumi invokes the Scala language runtime to run it, the Besom SDK evaluates resources and exchanges registrations with Pulumi, and Pulumi provisions them through providers; users can then inspect stack outputs or destroy resources. The repository also includes package code generation, configuration helpers, JSON support, and RPC protocol definitions. Some runtime links are documented but their implementation was not excerpted, so those links are dashed.
